hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom AMM hook for Uniswap v4 that integrates with Euler Finance vaults. In beforeSwap, it handles full swap execution: taking input tokens into Euler vaults via a custom curve invariant (CurveLib), withdrawing output tokens from vaults, and returning a BeforeSwapDelta. Designed as a delegatecall proxy implementation; beforeAddLiquidity and beforeDonate always revert.
